text.content:
Every hero has three tracks. Race sets ability scores and the Race Grade Multiplier (RGM). Class (combat) sets Combat EL. Profession (trade, craft, knowledge) sets Craft EL. Ability scores are race + class + profession; nobody rolls them.

EL = grade index × 5 + rank index (Novice 1 … Master 5): F-Novice is 1, S-Master is 35. XP to the next rank = 50 × EL².

Unclassed (the tier below F): Combat EL 0, hit die d6, no class abilities. Heroes start Unclassed and are bound into a class for a fee.

Race grade rises only when class and profession are both at Master of the current grade. Combat EL and Craft EL may not differ by more than 10; the sheet warns before that.

GradeIndexRGM
F01
E11.3
D21.7
C32.2

S64.5

Every number on the hero sheet is the workbook's Character Sheet formula, checked against the workbook's own values for its pregen Vera and 200 more test characters.

  • Modifier = floor((score − 10) / 2). Save = modifier + training + Combat EL.
  • AC = 10 + DEX (capped by armour) + armour + gear bonus + armour training + Combat EL.
  • Max HP = max(hit die, round((die/2 + 0.5 + CON) × Combat EL × RGM)).
  • Attack = best of STR/DEX + weapon training + Combat EL. Spell DC = 10 + casting modifier + spell training + Combat EL.
  • Damage = (1 + Combat EL ÷ 4) weapon dice + a bonus that applies the RGM. Craft effort is the same with Craft EL and the best mental modifier.
  • Skill = modifier + training + the track's EL (Combat or Craft, per skill).
TrainingBonus

Roll d20 + modifier against a DC. Beat it by 10 for a critical success; miss by 10 for a critical failure. A natural 20 raises the result one step, a natural 1 lowers it one step.

Standard DC = 12 + the target's EL + 2 × its grade index.

Chat cards show the readout: 14 + 7 = 21 vs DC 19 · Success.

Each hero has 3 actions a turn, shown as pips on the sheet; they refill when the hero's turn starts. Spending more than you have only warns, so you can bend the rules mid-play.

ActionCostEffect
Strike1Attack vs AC. 2nd attack in a turn −4, 3rd and later −8. Critical: damage × 1.5.
Stride1Move one zone (Engaged, Near, Far, Distant).
Raise Guard1+2 AC until your next turn. Default, pending your answer
Aid1+2 to one ally's next check. Default, pending your answer
Stabilise1An Engaged ally at 0 HP stops Dying, no roll.
Recall Knowledge1A check to learn about a foe.
Interact1Draw, pick up, open, pull a lever.
Withdraw3Leave the fight.
Signatures and spellsas listedCost points: tier = points.

The points pool for signatures and spells is 3 + Combat EL, refilled by a long rest. Default, pending your answer

At 0 HP a hero gains Dying. At the start of each of their turns they make a recovery check: d20 + CON save vs DC 12. Default, pending your answer

  • Success: stable at 0 HP.
  • Failure: mark a pip. 3 pips in one fight: dead.
  • Stabilise (any ally, 1 action) or healing above 0 ends Dying.
  • Each time a hero recovers they gain Wounded; Wounded adds failed pips when Dying starts again that day.

Death is permanent only with the Undertaking world setting on (off by default). Otherwise a hero at 3 pips is Defeated: down until healed or rested.

Negotiations, hazards, chases and ruins run on the same engine as fights. A Scene (actor type "Scene") has Resistance (its hit points), a DC, and approaches. Each approach is Full, Half or None for a hero, by their class, profession or trained skills; the Scene sheet shows each hero's aptness before they try.

An attempt (1 action Default, pending your answer) is the approach's skill check vs the Scene DC. On a success the hero's effort (Craft effort for Craft skills, Strike damage for Combat skills) comes off Resistance: × 1 Full, × ½ Half, × 0 None, × 1.5 on a critical. A failure triggers a Setback when the approach says so; a critical failure always does. Setbacks can deal damage and damage loaned gear.

A Scene may have a clock, which ticks once per round when the Scene is in the combat tracker. When the clock runs out, the Scene is lost.

Fights can often be solved by a Scene instead, for the same reward.

NPC stats default to the Engine sheet's benchmarks and can be overridden on the sheet.

  • AC = 15 + EL + grade compensation. Attack = 5 + EL + grade compensation.
  • HP = (10 + 4 × EL) × RGM × role (minion ½, standard 1, elite 1½, boss 2½ Default, pending your answer).
  • Damage per round = 3 × EL × RGM (at least 1), shown as dice.

Short rest: spend hit dice (each heals hit die + CON); you have max(1, Combat EL) dice a day. Default, pending your answer Long rest: full HP and points; Dying and Wounded clear.

Money: 10 cp = 1 sp, 10 sp = 1 gp, 10 gp = 1 pp. Prices and wages × 3 per grade (a longsword is 15 gp at F, 45 gp at E).

Loaned gear carries a Loaned badge and a condition: intact, damaged or broken. Condition has no effect on rolls yet. Default, pending your answer
